context: Two coworkers debrief after a long accounting meeting
purpose: Teach: 支払わ/勘定/代行/名目/提唱/容認/容器/同日

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: やっと終わりましたね、あの長い勘定の打ち合わせ。
lines.en: It's finally over, that long accounting meeting.
lines.style: Relieved exhale after enduring a tedious session.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、部長が新しい経費処理のやり方を提唱してきて、話が全然進まなかった。
lines.en: Yeah, the manager kept advocating a new expense handling method, so things didn't progress at all.
lines.style: Tired complaint with a touch of dry exasperation.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: しかも研修の名目で出張費を落とすなんて、経理が容認するわけないですよね。
lines.en: And accounting would never accept writing off travel expenses under the name of training.
lines.style: Skeptical, lowered voice as if gossiping carefully with a wince.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本当に。今月支払わなきゃいけない請求書、まだ山ほど残ってるのに。
lines.en: Seriously. We still have a mountain of invoices left to pay this month.
lines.style: Frustrated sigh, rubbing the back of his neck.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: そういえば、印鑑の代行サービス、結局同日に頼んじゃいましたよ。
lines.en: By the way, I ended up requesting the stamp proxy service on the same day after all.
lines.style: Slightly sheepish confession with a small awkward laugh.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: それは助かる。書類を入れる容器、机の下の棚にありますから使ってください。
lines.en: That's a relief. The container for the documents is on the shelf under the desk, please use it.
lines.style: Practical, helpful tone, pointing toward the desk.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。じゃあ、コーヒーでも飲んでから残りを片付けましょうか。
lines.en: Thank you. Well then, shall we tackle the rest after grabbing a coffee?
lines.style: Warm suggestion, gently trying to lift the mood.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 賛成。正直、もう脳が限界ですよ。
lines.en: Agreed. Honestly, my brain is already at its limit.
lines.style: Half-laughing, genuinely worn-out admission of defeat.
